LanguageData.CC_GodB_HollinBound_Text: Two saplings have come up side by side overnight at {HOME}, on open ground between where {A} and {B} sleep. The two of them fought yesterday.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_HollinBound_Text_2: At {HOME} this morning there are two young trees standing side by side where there was only grass last night, between the beds of {A} and {B}, who fought the day before.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_HollinBound_Text_3: Overnight two saplings grew up together on open ground at {HOME}, halfway between where {A} and {B} sleep. The two fought yesterday and have not spoken since.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_Saw_HollinBound: {WHO} and {OTHER} stood together at the two saplings that came up between them overnight at {HOME}, the day after they fought.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_HollinStumps_Text: Brambles have grown up overnight round the last stump {A} left at {HOME}. {A} has felled {COUNT} trees in the past few days.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_HollinStumps_Text_2: The last stump {A} cut at {HOME} is ringed with brambles this morning, thick and green, though it was bare ground yesterday. {A} has cut down {COUNT} trees lately.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_HollinStumps_Text_3: At {HOME} a tangle of brambles has come up round a fresh stump, the last of the {COUNT} trees {A} has felled in the past few days.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_Saw_HollinStumps: {WHO} showed {OTHER} the brambles grown up round {OTHER}'s last stump at {HOME}, after many trees cut and few planted.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_SmoulderPraise_Text: As {A} finished the {THING} at {HOME}, the bench threw up a burst of heat and sparks.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_SmoulderPraise_Text_2: {A} has made a fine {THING} at {HOME}. At the last stroke the forge flared up hot and bright, and sparks flew round the bench.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_SmoulderPraise_Text_3: The {THING} {A} just finished at {HOME} is the best work seen there in a long while. The bench gave off a burst of heat and sparks as it was done.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_Saw_SmoulderPraise: {WHO} finished a fine {THING} at {HOME}, and the forge flared up with heat and sparks as it was done.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_SmoulderNearMiss_Text: Under the mountain at {HOME} the rock grumbled, and {B} pulled {A} back by the arm. A moment later a scatter of stones came down where {A} had been standing. Nobody was hurt.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_SmoulderNearMiss_Text_2: The rock overhead at {HOME} shifted with a low sound. {B} grabbed {A} and pulled them clear, and loose stones fell on the spot {A} had just left. Neither of them was hurt.
LanguageData.CC_GodB_SmoulderNearMiss_Text_3: Dust came down from the rock at {HOME}, and {B} hauled {A} back two steps just before a shower of stones landed where {A} stood. Both are unhurt.

LanguageData.CC_GodB_Saw_SmoulderNearMiss: {WHO} pulled {OTHER} back as the rock grumbled under the mountain at {HOME}, and stones came down where {OTHER} had stood.
